## LEARNED PREFERENCES (for What)
- [voice] Acknowledge what the client has already accomplished before giving instructions. 'I can see you've already activated your account, so the rest is easy' — validates their effort and reduces the instruction set.
- [voice] Don't preview what's coming later in the email ('one quick question at the bottom'). Just present content in order — the reader will get there. Previews waste words and feel like a sales tactic.
